title: Minimum braking distance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the distance car A needs to decelerate from 20 m/s to 6 m/s, obtaining 91 m.

title: Total distance from toll
description: Essential: Adds the 9 m constant-speed zone to the deceleration distance to find the total 100 m distance from the toll booth for part (1).

title: Car B's stopping distance
description: Important: Correctly calculates the total distance car B travels from the reaction point until its speed is 6 m/s, including the reaction time displacement.

title: Car A's position at B's stop
description: Important: Correctly determines car A's position (relative to the toll booth) at the moment car B reaches 6 m/s, accounting for its deceleration and constant-speed phases.

title: Minimum initial separation
description: Essential: Correctly subtracts car A's position from car B's total stopping distance to find the 66 m minimum initial separation for part (2).

title: Time coordination analysis
description: Optional: Analyzes or verifies that the timing of both cars' motions ensures the speed limit condition is met for car B.

title: Sign error in deceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses acceleration instead of deceleration (wrong sign) in kinematic equations, leading to incorrect distances or times.

title: Omit reaction time distance
description: Pitfall: Fails to include the distance car B travels at constant speed during the driver's 0.5 s reaction time.
